notes.title: Retiring the Game
notes.content:
Hello everyone, thank you for your support with Chaos Souls. The game will be removed from Steam soon but you'll still be able to play it if it's in your library.

The reason is because I feel that there are some major game design issues with the game that cannot be fixed as it is a game prototype that mainly uses placeholder assets. 

It also has a very small development budget since it is a game prototype and I'm unable to fix issues like making a better progression system, better monster designs and more attack variety and generally making the game better.

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

The next game that I'm working on is called [url=http://visualnoveler.com/destiny-chronicles]Destiny Chronicles[/url] a fantasy action JRPG.

Here are some of the recent gameplay development updates last month.

notes.title: Update 1.01 - Gameplay Improvements
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the knockback distance when you attack enemy minions
[*] Default controller icons will now be displayed now for tutorial tips for all controller types
[*] Flying enemies no longer have collision boxes
[*] Decreased the maximum height that flying enemies are allowed to fly
[*] Increased collision boxes for flying enemies
[*] Weak attacks now work on big orc
[*] Reduced big orc health from 250 to 200
[*] Increased the cooldown for Succubus boss's melee attack
[*] Increased hitbox size for green & blue bugs
[*] Decreased big blue bug's health from 400 to 320
[*] Reduced Orc warrior's health from 500 to 430
[*] Increased Orc warrior's melee hitbox to include melee range damage
[*] Reduced Plant's health from 450 to 360
[*] Reduced Wolf's health from 300 to 270
[*] Reduced Treant's health from 600 to 550
[*] Reduced Small Ice Golem's health from 600 to 500
[*] Reduced Rock Hurler's health from 450 to 380
[*] Decreased the rigidbody mass of most enemy minions
[*] Adjusted spawn positions of some flying enemies
[*] Unchecked Ambient Occulusion from default video settings
[/list]
